events.description: Escalation of violent group confrontation: police in riot gear engage with a crowd of protesters; multiple individuals are seen being pushed, grabbed, and falling to the ground; a line of officers advances while protesters resist or flee.

Direct physical combat between individuals: a person in black is seen grappling with and striking an officer (visible in f6–f8), while other officers intervene; mutual engagement with punches/grabs is evident.

An individual appears on the ground (f7–f8) while multiple officers surround and restrain them; one officer’s hand is near the person’s head/neck area in a manner suggesting excessive force against a non-resisting or subdued person.

A violent clash between police in riot gear and a group of black-clad individuals on a street, involving pushing, shoving, grappling, and at least one person being knocked to the ground; the confrontation escalates and spreads across the street with multiple participants engaged in physical struggle.

Multiple instances of mutual physical combat: officers and black-clad individuals are seen grabbing, striking, and wrestling each other (e.g., f0–f3 show direct grappling; f5 shows a person falling after contact; f10–f12 show close-quarters tussling).

A person is on the ground (visible in f5) while others stand over or move past them; though not clearly struck while down, the context of ongoing violence and proximity suggests potential vulnerability and risk of further harm during the chaotic clash.

A sustained physical confrontation occurs between a group of individuals in dark clothing (some hooded) and a line of uniformed officers in high-visibility vests and helmets. The interaction involves pushing, shoving, and close physical contact, with participants grappling and attempting to move past or displace the police line. The camera operator remains embedded within the crowd throughout, capturing dynamic, chaotic close-quarters engagement.

Multiple individuals in dark clothing engage in close physical grappling and shoving; one person is pushed backward while others surround and press in, with visible arm contact and body tension consistent with mutual combat.

A dense, agitated crowd moves dynamically with repeated pushing, shoving, and clustering around central figures; the collective behavior shows coordinated pressure and instability, exceeding peaceful protest or casual gathering, consistent with violent group unrest.

A large group of individuals, many wearing black clothing and face coverings, engage in coordinated aggressive movement and physical confrontation in a street setting. The scene evolves from a tense standoff into active pushing, shoving, and chaotic motion involving dozens of people, consistent with a violent group clash.

Multiple pairs of individuals are seen engaged in direct physical combat: grabbing, striking, and wrestling. In frames f3–f6, individuals are visibly grappling; in f10–f12, a person in a red backpack is struck and pushed back while others exchange blows or holds.

In frame f6, a person in light clothing appears on the ground while others stand over them; in f7, the same individual remains prone as surrounding individuals move aggressively nearby, suggesting a helpless victim being targeted during the chaos.

A large group of individuals, many wearing black clothing and face coverings, are engaged in violent collective unrest. They are seen pushing, shoving, and moving aggressively toward a line of uniformed officers (visible from f15 onward), with raised arms, throwing motions, and chaotic movement consistent with a riot. The scene includes coordinated group actions, not isolated altercations.

In the initial frames, multiple individuals are seen in direct physical contact: grappling, grabbing, and striking each other in close proximity (e.g., f0–f2 show people locked in hand-to-hand struggle; f3 shows a person being pushed down). This constitutes mutual physical combat among several participants.

At f3 (41.5s), a person in light clothing is on the ground while others surround and appear to strike or stomp on them; by f4 (42.0s), the individual remains prone as others move over them. This suggests an attack on a helpless victim, though visibility is partially obstructed.

Multiple individuals engage in mutual physical combat: a person in black hooded jacket grapples with another individual (visible from f4 onward), while others nearby also appear to be pushing, shoving, and wrestling. The interaction involves sustained close contact, grabbing, and attempts to overpower—consistent with mutual combat rather than one-sided abuse.

A large group of civilians confronts a line of riot police in formation; the scene escalates into chaotic movement, pushing, and multiple physical altercations across the crowd, indicating collective violent unrest beyond peaceful protest. Police remain in defensive posture while civilians surge forward and engage in scuffles.

Two individuals in dark clothing engage in mutual physical combat: one grabs the other’s upper body/neck area while the other resists and pushes back; this occurs near the center of the frame with onlookers nearby.

A group of people (at least 6–8) converge around a visible pool of blood on the ground, with some raising arms or moving aggressively toward the center; police line remains static in background, indicating collective violent unrest rather than isolated incident.

One person in black hooded jacket appears to push or shove a person in purple skirt who is off-balance and being held by another individual; the victim shows no active resistance and appears vulnerable during the interaction.

A person in a black jacket and jeans lunges forward and appears to strike or grapple with a police officer in high-visibility vest and helmet; the officer recoils slightly, indicating physical contact.

After the initial contact, the same individual in black continues to push or shove the officer who is now off-balance and stepping back; the officer does not appear to be actively resisting at this moment, suggesting a one-sided assault.

Sustained violent group confrontation: multiple civilians (some masked, some holding objects) engage with a line of riot police; visible pushing, shoving, and aggressive posturing occur across several frames, with blood on the ground indicating prior injury. The scene shows collective unrest beyond isolated scuffles.

A group of hooded individuals confronts a line of police officers in high-visibility vests and helmets behind barriers; multiple participants raise fists, push forward, and engage in coordinated aggressive posturing toward law enforcement, indicating collective violent unrest.
